datasets.name: ai_gateway_usage
queryLines:
SELECT
  event_time,
  endpoint_name,
  request_id,
  destination_name,
  destination_id,
  lower(
  regexp_replace(destination_model, '[ .]+', '-')
) AS destination_model,
  destination_type,
  requester,
  requester_type,
  api_type,
  input_tokens,
  output_tokens,
  total_tokens,
  token_details.cache_read_input_tokens as cache_read_input_tokens,
  token_details.output_reasoning_tokens as output_reasoning_tokens,
  latency_ms,
  time_to_first_byte_ms,
  status_code,
  latency_ms/1000 as latency_s,
  response_content_type,
  time_to_first_byte_ms/1000 as time_to_first_byte_s,
  CASE WHEN status_code >= 400 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END as error_count,
  workspace_id,
   CASE
      WHEN input_tokens > 0 THEN
        ROUND((COALESCE(token_details.cache_read_input_tokens, 0) * 100.0 / input_tokens), 2)
      ELSE 0
    END as cache_hit_ratio_pct
FROM `system`.`ai_gateway`.`usage` WHERE
event_time BETWEEN :date_range.min AND :date_range.max

datasets.name: 33f2b125
queryLines:
SELECT
      DATE_TRUNC('day', event_time) as event_date,
      endpoint_name,
      workspace_id,
      COUNT(*) as total_requests,
      SUM(error_count) as total_errors,
      ROUND((SUM(error_count) * 100.0 / COUNT(*)), 2) as error_rate_pct
  FROM (
      SELECT
        event_time,
        endpoint_name,
        workspace_id,
        status_code,
        CASE WHEN status_code >= 400 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END as error_count
      FROM `system`.`ai_gateway`.`usage` WHERE
      event_time BETWEEN :date_range.min AND :date_range.max
  )
  GROUP BY event_date, endpoint_name, workspace_id
  HAVING COUNT(*) >= 10
  ORDER BY event_date, endpoint_name

datasets.name: 6887c228
queryLines:
WITH base_data AS (
    SELECT
      event_time,
      endpoint_name,
      request_id,
      destination_name,
      destination_id,
      destination_model,
      destination_type,
      requester,
      requester_type,
      api_type,
      input_tokens,
      output_tokens,
      total_tokens,
      token_details.cache_read_input_tokens as cache_read_input_tokens,
      token_details.output_reasoning_tokens as output_reasoning_tokens,
      latency_ms,
      time_to_first_byte_ms,
      status_code,
      latency_ms/1000 as latency_s,
      response_content_type,
      time_to_first_byte_ms/1000 as time_to_first_byte_s,
      CASE WHEN status_code >= 400 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END as error_count,
      workspace_id,
      CASE
          WHEN input_tokens > 0 THEN ROUND((token_details.cache_read_input_tokens * 100.0 / input_tokens), 2)
          ELSE 0
        END as cache_hit_ratio_pct,
      CASE
        WHEN url LIKE '%/cursor/v1/chat/completions%' THEN 'Cursor'
        WHEN user_agent LIKE 'claude-cli%' THEN 'Claude Code'
        WHEN user_agent LIKE 'GeminiCLI%' THEN 'Gemini CLI'
        WHEN user_agent LIKE 'codex_cli%' THEN 'Codex CLI'
        ELSE 'None'
      END AS coding_agent
    FROM `system`.`ai_gateway`.`usage`
    WHERE (:workspace_id IS NULL OR array_contains(:workspace_id, workspace_id)) AND
    event_time BETWEEN :date_range.min AND :date_range.max
  )
  SELECT *
  FROM base_data
  WHERE coding_agent != 'None'

datasets.name: 3ca97c03
queryLines:
SELECT
    endpoint_name,
    workspace_id,
    SUM(total_tokens) as total_tokens,
    COUNT(*) as total_requests
  FROM `system`.`ai_gateway`.`usage` WHERE
  event_time BETWEEN :date_range.min AND :date_range.max
  GROUP BY endpoint_name, workspace_id
  ORDER BY total_tokens DESC

datasets.name: ca48d560
queryLines:
SELECT
    LOWER(destination_model) as model_name,
    SUM(total_tokens) as total_tokens,
    COUNT(*) as total_requests
  FROM `system`.`ai_gateway`.`usage`
  WHERE (:workspace_id IS NULL OR array_contains(:workspace_id, workspace_id)) AND
    destination_model != 'null' AND
    event_time BETWEEN :date_range.min AND :date_range.max
  GROUP BY model_name
  ORDER BY total_tokens DESC

datasets.name: a93367bb
queryLines:
SELECT
    requester,
    SUM(total_tokens) as total_tokens,
    COUNT(*) as total_requests
  FROM `system`.`ai_gateway`.`usage`
  WHERE (:workspace_id IS NULL OR array_contains(:workspace_id, workspace_id)) AND
  event_time BETWEEN :date_range.min AND :date_range.max

datasets.name: 232feb79
queryLines:
SELECT
    endpoint_name,
    COUNT(*) as total_requests,
    workspace_id,
    SUM(COALESCE(token_details.cache_read_input_tokens, 0)) as total_cache_tokens,
    ROUND(SUM(COALESCE(token_details.cache_read_input_tokens, 0)) * 100.0 / NULLIF(SUM(input_tokens), 0), 2) as avg_cache_hit_ratio_pct
  FROM `system`.`ai_gateway`.`usage` WHERE
  event_time BETWEEN :date_range.min AND :date_range.max AND
  destination_model != 'null'
  GROUP BY workspace_id, endpoint_name
  HAVING total_cache_tokens > 0
  ORDER BY avg_cache_hit_ratio_pct DESC

datasets.name: 814e19c1
queryLines:
WITH base_data AS (
        SELECT
          requester,
          DATE(event_time) as usage_date,
          total_tokens,
          CASE
            WHEN url LIKE '%/cursor/v1/chat/completions%' THEN 'Cursor'
            WHEN user_agent LIKE 'claude-cli%' THEN 'Claude Code'
            WHEN user_agent LIKE 'GeminiCLI%' THEN 'Gemini CLI'
            WHEN user_agent LIKE 'codex_cli%' THEN 'Codex CLI'
            ELSE 'None'
          END AS coding_agent
        FROM `system`.`ai_gateway`.`usage`
        WHERE (:workspace_id IS NULL OR array_contains(:workspace_id, workspace_id)) AND
        event_time BETWEEN :date_range.min AND :date_range.max
 )
    SELECT
      requester,
      coding_agent,
      COUNT(*) as request_count,
      SUM(total_tokens) as total_token_count,
      COUNT(DISTINCT usage_date) as num_active_days
    FROM base_data
    WHERE coding_agent != 'None'
    GROUP BY requester, coding_agent
    ORDER BY total_token_count DESC

datasets.name: 668a73a9
queryLines:
WITH base_data AS (
      SELECT
        requester,
        DATE(event_time) as usage_date,
        total_tokens,
        status_code,
        CASE
          WHEN url LIKE '%/cursor/v1/chat/completions%' THEN 'Cursor'
          WHEN user_agent LIKE 'claude-cli%' THEN 'Claude Code'
          WHEN user_agent LIKE 'GeminiCLI%' THEN 'Gemini CLI'
          WHEN user_agent LIKE 'codex_cli%' THEN 'Codex CLI'
          ELSE 'None'
        END AS coding_agent
      FROM `system`.`ai_gateway`.`usage`
      WHERE (:workspace_id IS NULL OR array_contains(:workspace_id, workspace_id)) AND
      status_code = '429' AND 
      event_time BETWEEN :date_range.min AND :date_range.max
    )
  SELECT
    requester,
    coding_agent,
    COUNT(*) as request_count,
    SUM(total_tokens) as total_token_count,
    COUNT(DISTINCT usage_date) as num_active_days
  FROM base_data
  WHERE coding_agent != 'None'
  GROUP BY requester, coding_agent
  ORDER BY total_token_count DESC

datasets.name: 58a42a13
queryLines:
-- temp view as a fallback if table_name is not provided --
  CREATE OR REPLACE TEMP VIEW `table_name` AS
  SELECT
    CAST(NULL AS STRUCT<
      time_unix_nano: BIGINT,
      attributes: STRUCT<type: STRING>,
      value: DOUBLE
    >) AS sum,
    CAST(NULL AS STRING) AS name
  WHERE 1 = 0;

  WITH filtered_data AS (
    SELECT
      to_timestamp(sum.time_unix_nano / 1e9) AS ts,
      name,
      sum.attributes.type AS attribute_type,
      sum.value AS value
    FROM IDENTIFIER(:table_name)
    WHERE to_timestamp(sum.time_unix_nano / 1e9) BETWEEN :date_range.min AND :date_range.max
  )
  SELECT
    ts,
    SUM(CASE
          WHEN name = 'claude_code.lines_of_code.count' AND attribute_type = 'added' THEN value
          ELSE 0
        END) AS lines_added,
    SUM(CASE
          WHEN name = 'claude_code.lines_of_code.count' AND attribute_type = 'removed' THEN value
          ELSE 0
        END) AS lines_removed,
    SUM(CASE
          WHEN name = 'claude_code.session.count' THEN value
          ELSE 0
        END) AS sessions_started,
    SUM(CASE
          WHEN name = 'claude_code.pull_request.count' THEN value
          ELSE 0
        END) AS pull_requests_created,
    SUM(CASE
          WHEN name = 'claude_code.commit.count' THEN value
          ELSE 0
        END) AS commits_created,
    SUM(CASE
          WHEN name = 'claude_code.active_time.total' THEN value/60
          ELSE 0
        END) AS active_time_total
  FROM filtered_data
  GROUP BY ts
  ORDER BY ts
